`v0.13.0` fixes freezes on Intel graphics, offers CPU rendering when GPU rendering never reaches the screen, and lets Win+G reach Omarchy.

# Fixes

* Fix Omarchy freezing on Intel graphics when opening menus or the Hyprland configuration editor with GPU rendering on (#361, #367, #362)
* When GPU rendering never shows the desktop in the Omarchy window, the launcher now offers CPU rendering after two minutes instead of Automatic picking GPU again on every start (#366, #358)
* The health check no longer offers Restart while a system package update is still running (#365, #359)
* Win+G and Win+Alt+G now reach Omarchy's window grouping. Windows' Xbox Game Bar still opens on them too; press Esc to close it (#369, #370, #368)

## Dev

* Build runtime r25 with the Intel buffer upload fixes (#361, #367)
